# Obstetric theatres

!!! info "Definition"
    An obstetric procedure theatre is a dedicated operating space used for childbirth-related surgical and procedural interventions, typically within labour ward or maternity services.

## Activity classification

A maternity spell may require capacity for assessment, delivery and postnatal care, across different functional areas. This calculation estimates theatre time required for caesarean deliveries.

Activity is limited to maternity spells with a recorded birth event and a primary procedure code in either of the following groups:

* R17: Elective caesarean section delivery
* R18: Other caesarean section delivery

## Calculating capacity

#### Pathway: deriving workload

Convert qualifying caesarean section procedures into procedure hours using the assumed procedure time.

!!! quote ""

    $$
    \text{Procedure hours}
    =
    \text{Procedures}
    \times
    \frac{\text{Procedure time (minutes)}}{60}
    $$

#### Operating model: converting workload to capacity

Calculate the required number of obstetric theatres by dividing procedure hours by the product of the service's annual planned operating hours and the assumed utilisation rate.

!!! quote ""

    $$
    \text{Required obstetric theatres}
    =
    \frac{\text{Procedure hours}}
    {\text{Annual planned operating hours} \times \text{Utilisation rate}}
    $$

## Assumptions

Assumptions may apply to an individual subgroup, several subgroups or all groups.

| Subgroup | Assumption | Type |
| --- | --- | --- |
| All groups | Procedure time | Pathway |
| All groups | Utilisation rate | Operational |
| All groups | Annual operational hours | Operational |


## Notes

* Obstetric theatres require 24-hour availability to support emergency activity. The model estimates capacity based on assumed planned operating hours, with provision outside these hours treated as emergency reserve capacity.

??? info "Technical details"
    **Capacity outputs**

    * `OBSTETRIC_PROC_THEATRES`

    **Conversion archetype:** time utilisation · `FRM_TIME_UTIL`

    **Operational constraint:** available operational time, adjusted for utilisation

    **Workload object:** `procedure_hours`

    **Classification expressions**

    | Subgroup | Expression |
    | --- | --- |
    | All groups | ((`CLASS_MATERNITY` AND `CLASS_BIRTH_EVENT` AND `CLASS_BIRTH_ELECTIVE_C_SECTION`) OR (`CLASS_MATERNITY` AND `CLASS_BIRTH_EVENT` AND `CLASS_BIRTH_NON_ELECTIVE_C_SECTION`)) |

    **Classification definitions**

    | ID | Definition | Rule |
    | --- | --- | --- |
    | `CLASS_MATERNITY` | Maternity admissions | (admimeth starts with 3 OR tretspef IN (501, 560)) AND sex = "2" AND age BETWEEN 13 AND 55 |
    | `CLASS_BIRTH_EVENT` | Birth event recorded | Not documented |
    | `CLASS_BIRTH_ELECTIVE_C_SECTION` | R17 elective caesarean | Not documented |
    | `CLASS_BIRTH_NON_ELECTIVE_C_SECTION` | R18 other caesarean | Not documented |

    **Classification notes**

    * `CLASS_MATERNITY`: See the Demand Model definition of maternity activity: https://connect.strategyunitwm.nhs.uk/nhp/project_information/data_extraction/inpatients.html#group

    **Assumption references**

    | Subgroup | Assumption ID |
    | --- | --- |
    | All groups | `OBSTETRIC_THEATRE_PROC_TIME` |
    | All groups | `OBSTETRIC_THEATRE_UTIL` |
    | All groups | `OBSTETRIC_THEATRE_ANNUAL_OPERATIONAL_HOURS` |
